description.text: Founded in 2011, NXTP is Latin America’s premier B2B-focused, early-stage venture capital fund. We are committed to entrepreneurs in the region and to the incredible opportunity we see to build large tech-enabled companies that transform how business is done around the world.

targetApplicants.text: Auth0 is an enterprise identity & authentication platform. Developer-centric and product-led, they exemplify what we find so attractive in B2B SaaS startups. They were acquired by Okta in May 2021 for $6.5bn. We are proud to have been their first check back in 2014.
